ng.policy.baseline_allow.remediation: Apply remaining policy layers and enforce returned obligations.

ng.policy.identity_unknown.description: Principal is not registered for its tenant and kind.
ng.policy.identity_unknown.remediation: Authenticate the caller and register the authoritative principal.

ng.policy.tenant_mismatch.description: A resource belongs to a different tenant.
ng.policy.tenant_mismatch.remediation: Use resources in the authenticated principal tenant.

ng.policy.operation_unknown.description: Operation kind or name is not registered.
ng.policy.operation_unknown.remediation: Declare the operation before enabling access.

ng.policy.destination_unknown.description: Destination identity, URI or kind is not registered.
ng.policy.destination_unknown.remediation: Register the exact destination and handling properties.

ng.policy.purpose_undeclared.remediation: Supply a purpose declared by the application policy.

ng.policy.context_incomplete.description: Application or environment is not registered.
ng.policy.context_incomplete.remediation: Supply authenticated application and environment context.
